_comment: Warbanner totem (content pass C6, plan-content-zones12.md §B): the Orc Warlord's invulnerability gate — encounter-spawned at the warbanner-1/-2 anchors, never a zone spawn. Killable stationary object on the bramble body pattern: collisionLayer 99 = PlayerStatic+Action+Viewport+MobStatic (solid, damageable by player auras), collisionMask 16 = Border only. NO resistances key — any damage fells it (unlike the gated bramble/rockfall obstacles). orc faction, so WarbannerShield armors nearby orcs/grunts (targetsAllies), the totem stays soft itself, and the army line ignores it. XP 0 — it is a mechanic, not a reward. All values [PLACEHOLDER]
